title.zh: 特朗普公布超60亿美元科研计划，英伟达、OpenAI等11家科技巨头承诺24亿美元AI资源
title.en: 特朗普公布超60亿美元科研计划，英伟达、OpenAI等11家科技巨头承诺24亿美元AI资源

current_state.zh: The White House announced a $6B+ science and research initiative spanning AI, quantum computing, biotech and talent, with 11 tech companies — including NVIDIA ($1B), AMD ($500M), OpenAI ($200M), Anthropic and Google ($150M each) — pledging $2.4B in AI tools and compute to the Genesis Mission for use across more than 15 federal agencies.
